# HEIC test fixture

`with-alpha-512x512.heic` is copied without modification from libheif
v1.23.5, `tests/data/with-alpha-512x512.heic`.

Source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/v1.23.5/tests/data/with-alpha-512x512.heic

The libheif LGPL-3.0 license is in `libheif-COPYING.txt`.
This synthetic fixture is not a student's submission. The generated
extension does not include it; it is used in the source package tests.

## Binary PowerPoint fixture

`basic-test.ppt` is copied unchanged from Apache POI's
`test-data/slideshow/basic_test_ppt_file.ppt` at commit
`12c3688d130035f3dc2ca2a0f50d929456435a93`.
SHA-256: `e8fd4c38ad72ce3735acbca0b60dd5870fb60f819c169e3947d166f4f1bcc79d`.
Source: https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/12c3688d130035f3dc2ca2a0f50d929456435a93/test-data/slideshow/basic_test_ppt_file.ppt
Upstream license and notice are in `apache-poi-LICENSE.txt` and
`apache-poi-NOTICE.txt`. It contains generic test text, not student data,
and is included only in source/test packages. The installable PPTX demo
is generated by `scripts/demo-pptx.mjs`.
